welcomeCopy: A shared view of what matters. Explore the care experience built around older adults and the people who support them.
serviceNotice: This application does not provide medical advice, real-time monitoring, authentication or emergency services.
professionalCopy: Review pending alerts, find assigned patients and explore their care history.
familyCopy: See your loved one's latest records and follow the people involved in their care.
older-adultCopy: Review your language and notification preferences in an accessible space.
foundationCopy: Base navigation and responsive layout for the care experience.
notFoundCopy: The address does not match a page in this application.
overviewCopy: A clear view of the alerts that need your attention.
invalidData: The source returned an unknown priority
errorCopy: No conclusion can be drawn from this failed query. Try again.
staleCopy: Previously loaded information remains visible below and is not up to date.
stale: Not updated · Showing the last successful query
emptyCopy: No records match the current selection.
patientsCopy: Find the right person and continue their care journey.
noRecords: No measurements have been recorded yet
outdatedRecord: No record in the last 48 hours
unavailablePatientCopy: This patient does not exist or is outside this profile's assigned care network.
historyIntro: Explore dated records and their origin in one place.
readOnlyCopy: Read-only access. Clinical actions and persistent changes are unavailable.
historyCopy: Recorded information, sorted from newest to oldest.
dateError: Enter valid dates with the start on or before the end.
familyOverviewCopy: The latest recorded information, shared with your care circle.
noClinicalConclusion: No recorded alerts does not mean the person is clinically well. These are dated records; this view does not offer live monitoring.
datedRecordsNotice: Alerts are based on dated records. This view does not provide live monitoring or replace a professional assessment.
restrictedNotes: This view contains the authorized change history. Private clinical notes are not shared.
preferencesCopy: Choose how you read information and receive updates.
languageCopy: Your choice is remembered on this browser.
notificationCopy: Choose optional channels for each event.
localPreferences: Preferences are stored only in this browser, separately for each role. No messages are sent.
mandatoryCopy: Security notices are mandatory and cannot be disabled.
verifyChannel: This channel must be verified before activation.
mandatoryNotice: Required security notices cannot be disabled.
storageError: Browser storage is unavailable. Your changes could not be saved.
languageSaved: Language preference saved on this browser.
historyUnchanged: Changing a channel does not erase previously recorded history.
termsCopy: This application does not contact healthcare providers or emergency services. The role selector is not an authentication or authorization system.
termsStorage: Only language and notification preferences are saved locally. No real accounts or clinical records are collected. Clear browser site data to remove these preferences.
